{
  "name": "revenue_v1",
  "label": "Revenue (v1, deprecated)",
  "description": "The old revenue number: what customers paid, VAT included, by sale date, with returns ignored. Kept so old questions get a pointer to net_revenue instead of a silent wrong answer.",
  "status": "deprecated",
  "version": 1,
  "owner": "finance",
  "owner_team": "@your-org/finance",
  "certified_on": "2026-03-01",
  "recertify_by": "2026-05-30",
  "agent_notes": "Deprecated. Do not answer with this metric; use net_revenue and say why.",
  "decision": {
    "id": "DR-005",
    "title": "Deprecate revenue_v1 in favor of net_revenue",
    "decision": "`revenue_v1` stays defined (`dbt/models/semantic/fct_sales.yml`) with\n`status: deprecated` and `replaced_by: net_revenue`. It is not certified.\nAgents and dashboards must not answer with it: they say it is deprecated,\nname `net_revenue`, and explain the difference (VAT and returns)."
  },
  "golden_questions": 2,
  "caveats": [
    "pos_sync_lag:<store>: the store's POS data does not cover the whole period yet (DR-004)"
  ],
  "replaced_by": "net_revenue"
}
